verdict.rationale: DeepSeek documents tool/function calling as a first-class API feature with a maintained guide and runnable OpenAI-format examples, plus tool-calls pricing entries, but the docs are thin on typed schemas, parallel calls, and multi-step agent-loop patterns. A hands-on community report directly contradicts reliability, describing 'excessive duplicated FC, hallucinated names/params' in real usage. missing for 10: explicit documentation of parallel/multi-step tool call sequencing, typed tool schema examples beyond basic JSON mode, and independent corroboration that function calling works reliably in agent loops.
